leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a graph data structure to represent flight tickets as edges between airports
Initialize a priority queue or sorted adjacency list to maintain lexical order of destinations
Implement a depth-first search (DFS) algorithm to traverse the flight itinerary
Manipulate the graph by removing visited edges to prevent reuse of tickets
Apply backtracking to handle dead-end paths and find the valid itinerary
Integrate the graph construction and DFS traversal to reconstruct the complete itinerary
Render the final itinerary as an ordered array of airport codes
